shortDescription.default: Page views and unique visitors for SharePoint sites.

longDescription.default: HitCounter records page views on modern SharePoint pages, including in-page navigation, and keeps long-term totals in SharePoint lists the tenant owns.

features.title: HitCounter tracker
features.description: Adds the HitCounter tracker: to a site when the app is added there (elements.xml), or to every site when the app is made available to all sites (ClientSideInstance.xml, which registers it in Tenant Wide Extensions).
